question: Which Article authorises the President to appoint the Governor of a State as the administrator of an adjoining Union territory?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Article 239(2).**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 239(2) **of the Indian Constitution authorizes the **President **to **appoint the Governor** of a State as the** administrator** of an adjoining Union territory.
 
• This provision is applicable in cases where the** Governor** is required to** discharge the functions** of the administrator of an adjoining Union territory in the absence of a** regular appointment.**
 
• The Governor, when appointed as the administrator of the Union territory, exercises the **powers and functions** of the **President** in relation to that territory.
 
• This provision is aimed at ensuring **effective governance** of the Union territory by utilizing the **expertise and experience** of the Governor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (Article 238(2)) refers to the** power of the President** to make regulations for the** peace, progress, and good government **of certain Union territories.
 
• Option 3 (Article 237(2)) deals with the appointment of administrators for **Union territories** other than **Delhi and Puducherry.**
 
• Option 4 (Article 231(2)) pertains to the **power of the Governor** to address the State Legislature at the commencement of the** first session** after each **general election** and the beginning of the first session of each year.
